defense_contracts.raw_text: General Dynamics Mission Systems Scottsdale, Arizona, has been awarded a $88,064,639 ceiling increase modification P00080 to previously awarded contract (HQ085022C0007) for Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture in support of the Tracking and Transport ground segment systems engineering integration and development. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $1,243,578,839 from $1,155,514,199. Work will be performed at Scottsdale, Arizona and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2029. Fiscal 2026 research development test and evaluation funds in the amount of $58,415,106 are being obligated at time of award. The Missile Warning and Tracking Portfolio Acquisition Executive, supported by the Space Development Agency, Washington, D.C, is the contracting activity.

Raytheon, Tucson, Arizona, is being awarded a noncompetitive, multi-year undefinitized contract action on a new contract (HQ0851-27-C-E001). The base value of this contract is $4,432,040,944 with a total value, including options, of $6,342,404,516. Under this contract, the contractor will manufacture and assemble Standard Missile-3 Block IB All-Up-Rounds for the government. The work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona; and Huntsville, Alabama, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 31, 2034. Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $454,215,132 are being obligated on this award. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity. (Awarded on Oct. 7, 2026).

Aegis Aerospace Inc., Webster, Texas, has been awarded a $9,359,118 modification (P00001) to a previously awarded contract (FA8809-26-F-B003) for transitioning missions from the Department of War human-rated payload support task order. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $34,323,859 from $24,964,741. Work will be performed at Houston, Texas, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2034. Fiscal 2026 research and development funds in the amount of $654,507 are being obligated at time of award. The Space Systems Command, Kirtland, Air Force Base, Albuquerque, New Mexico, is the contracting activity.
